activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

amount_currency.help: The amount expressed in an optional other currency if it is a multi-currency entry.

auto_post.help: Specify whether this entry is posted automatically on its accounting date, and any similar recurring invoices.

auto_post_until.help: This recurring move will be posted up to and including this date.

bank_partner_id.help: Technical field to get the domain on the bank

campaign_id.help: This is a name that helps you keep track of your different campaign efforts, e.g. Fall_Drive, Christmas_Special

company_price_include.help: Default on whether the sales price used on the product and invoices with this Company includes its taxes.

country_code.help:
The ISO country code in two chars. 
You can use this field for quick search.

direction_sign.help: Multiplicator depending on the document type, to convert a price into a balance

fiscal_position_id.help: Fiscal positions are used to adapt taxes and accounts for particular customers or sales orders/invoices. The default value comes from the customer.

foreign_currency_id.help: The optional other currency if it is a multi-currency entry.

invoice_cash_rounding_id.help: Defines the smallest coinage of the currency that can be used to pay by cash.

invoice_currency_rate.help: Currency rate from company currency to document currency.

invoice_incoterm_id.help: International Commercial Terms are a series of predefined commercial terms used in international transactions.

invoice_origin.help: The document(s) that generated the invoice.

invoice_vendor_bill_id.help: Auto-complete from a previous bill or refund.

is_being_sent.help: Is the move being sent asynchronously

is_move_sent.help: It indicates that the invoice/payment has been sent or the PDF has been generated.

is_self_billing.help: This journal is for self-billing invoices. Invoices will be created using a different sequence per partner.

journal_group_id.help:
By default, all journals post to the Statutory Ledger (Local GAAP). 
Specifying a ledger allows you to isolate IFRS, Tax, or Intercompany adjustments without affecting local statutory accounts.

medium_id.help: This is the method of delivery, e.g. Postcard, Email, or Banner Ad

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

no_followup.help: Exclude this journal entry from Reminder reports.

partner_bank_id.help: Bank Account Number to which the invoice will be paid. A Company bank account if this is a Customer Invoice or Vendor Credit Note, otherwise a Partner bank account number.

partner_shipping_id.help: The delivery address will be used in the computation of the fiscal position.

payment_reference.help: The payment reference to set on journal items.

purchase_id.help: Auto-complete from a past purchase order.

purchase_vendor_bill_id.help: Auto-complete from a previous bill, refund, or purchase order.

purchase_warning_text.help: Internal warning for the partner or the products as set by the user.

qr_code_method.help: Type of QR-code to be generated for the payment of this invoice, when printing it. If left blank, the first available and usable method will be used.

quick_edit_total_amount.help:
Use this field to encode the total amount of the invoice.
Odoo will automatically create one invoice line with default values to match it.

reconciled_payment_ids.help: Payments that have been reconciled with this invoice.

restrict_mode_hash_table.help: If ticked, when an entry is posted, we retroactively hash all moves in the sequence from the entry back to the last hashed entry. The hash can also be performed on demand by the Secure Entries wizard.

sale_warning_text.help: Internal warning for the partner or the products as set by the user.

secured.help: The entry is secured with an inalterable hash.

source_id.help: This is the source of the link, e.g. Search Engine, another domain, or name of email list

tax_cash_basis_created_move_ids.help: The cash basis entries created from the taxes on this entry, when reconciling its lines.

tax_cash_basis_origin_move_id.help: The journal entry from which this tax cash basis journal entry has been created.

tax_totals.help: Edit Tax amounts if you encounter rounding issues.

allow_express_checkout.help: This controls whether customers can use express payment methods. Express checkout enables customers to pay with Google Pay and Apple Pay from which address information is collected at payment.

allow_tokenization.help: This controls whether customers can save their payment methods as payment tokens. A payment token is an anonymous link to the payment method details saved in the provider's database, allowing the customer to reuse it for a next purchase.

auth_msg.help: The message displayed if payment is authorized

available_country_ids.help: The countries in which this payment provider is available. Leave blank to make it available in all countries.

available_currency_ids.help: The currencies available with this payment provider. Leave empty not to restrict any.

available_pricelist_ids.help: Only allow this payment provider when the partner's pricelist matches one of these.

cancel_msg.help: The message displayed if the order is cancelled during the payment process

capture_manually.help: Capture the amount from Odoo, when the delivery is completed. Use this if you want to charge your customers cards only when you are sure you can ship the goods to them.

code.help: The technical code of this payment provider.

done_msg.help: The message displayed if the order is successfully done after the payment process

express_checkout_form_view_id.help: The template rendering the express payment methods' form.

inline_form_view_id.help: The template rendering the inline payment form when making a direct payment

is_live.help: If live mode is disabled, a fake payment is processed through a test payment interface. This mode is advised when setting up the provider.

is_published.help: Whether the provider is visible on the website or not. Tokens remain functional but are only visible on manage forms.

journal_id.help: The journal in which the successful transactions are posted.

main_currency_id.help: The main currency of the company, used to display monetary fields.

maximum_amount.help: The maximum payment amount that this payment provider is available for. Leave blank to make it available for any payment amount.

minimum_amount.help: The minimum payment amount that this payment provider is available for. Leave blank to make it available for any payment amount.

pending_msg.help: The message displayed if the order pending after the payment process

pre_msg.help: The message displayed to explain and help the payment process

qr_code.help: Enable the use of QR-codes when paying by wire transfer.

redirect_form_view_id.help: The template rendering a form submitted to redirect the user when making a payment

so_reference_type.help: You can set here the communication type that will appear on sales orders.The communication will be given to the customer when they choose the payment method.

support_refund.help: Refund is a feature allowing to refund customers directly from the payment in Odoo.

token_inline_form_view_id.help: The template rendering the inline payment form when making a payment by token.

payment.provider.order: module_state desc, is_published desc, sequence, name

capture_manually.help: Capture the amount from Odoo, when the delivery is completed. Use this if you want to charge your customers cards only when you are sure you can ship the goods to them.

child_transaction_ids.help: The child transactions of the transaction.

is_live.help: Whether the transaction happened in a production environment. False for transactions created before this tracking was implemented.

landing_route.help: The route the user is redirected to after the transaction

payment_method_code.help: The technical code of this payment method.

provider_code.help: The technical code of this payment provider.

provider_reference.help: The provider reference of the transaction

reference.help: The internal reference of the transaction

source_transaction_id.help: The source transaction of the related child transactions

state_message.help: The complementary information message about the state

tokenize.help: Whether a payment token should be created when post-processing the transaction
